answer: If a vote is granted after a single form, a factory of keys will outrun anyone present. Candidates book a 72-hour assay slot at the canyon mouth, cut one crystal core from a numbered face, and leave it on a public marble bench for two inspectors to re-weigh and re-hash. Cost is three days on site plus a refundable 40-unit bond released after both inspectors sign. Auditors match bench photos, core mass, and hash to the slot ticket, and drop reused tickets or copied timing. It breaks if one bond covers several cores, so each crystal core retires its own bond; unused bonds lapse at 72 hours.
